A lot of misinformation from legacy media about Starlink’s entry into South Africa. Here’s the truth 👇

• ❌ “Starlink wants to bypass B-BBEE”
✅ False — it supports transformation via EEIP, a legal framework already used by companies like Microsoft, IBM, and Amazon Web Services.

• ❌ “Starlink is asking for special treatment”
✅ No — it’s asking for equal rules so ALL satellite operators can compete fairly.

• ❌ “EEIP is less beneficial than equity deals”
✅ Reality

Low Birth Rate = Decline of Civilization

Humanity is dying.
